whatsapp.help_text:
🌟 *Instagram Auto-Posting Bot Guide*

This bot helps you prepare photos, videos, and carousels, generate AI captions via Google Gemini / Local LLM, apply stylish filters, overlay custom fonts, configure tags (#) and mentions (@), and publish directly to Instagram!

📸 *Supported Features:*
• *Photos, videos, and albums* (Stories, Feed, Reels, Carousels).
• 🎨 *7 aesthetic filters*: Golden Hour, Vintage, Cinema, B&W Noir, Vibrant, Soft Glow.
• 🔤 *5 decorative fonts*: Modern Sans, Handwriting, Elegant Serif, Retro Rounded, Accent Bold.
• 🤖 *AI Copywriter*: generate engaging captions with hashtags.

🚀 *How to create a post:*
1️⃣ Send a photo or video 📎.
2️⃣ Provide a topic/notes (or send *"done"* for auto-generation).
3️⃣ Review the post and confirm publication!

📋 *Commands:*
• *ping* — test connection (reply: pong)
• */status* — connection & server status
• */help* — help guide
• */tags* — preset hashtags
• */mentions* — constant mentions
• */cancel* — cancel current operation
whatsapp.status_footer: Send a photo, video, or message with a topic to prepare a new post.

👥 *Constant Mentions (@):*

• Mentions are used to tag co-authors or family accounts in Instagram.
• Configure the permanent list via the */mentions* command in Telegram bot.
